title: Guard zeroize feature-unification against oscore crate major bump
description: rust/lichen-oscore/Cargo.toml:25-33 direct aes/hmac zeroize pins guarantee zeroization only while the oscore fork uses the same aes 0.8/hmac 0.13 majors. If oscore bumps majors, two copies coexist, unification silently breaks, and the compile-time asserts in zeroize_asserts.rs:61,68 keep passing against the now-unused versions while real cipher/HMAC state goes unzeroized. Add a cargo-deny duplicate-versions check (or CI cargo tree -d gate) or at minimum a warning comment on the assert module.
